scrimBad: Text that is hard to read on the background of enlarged images: insufficient legibility.
fixNearest: Adjust to the nearest shade that passes
noNearTone: No nearby shade passes: also change the background colour concerned.
sampleSoft: Secondary text, caption of a work.
sampleScrim: Caption on the background of enlarged images
intro: Six base colours and their shades. An “auto” shade follows its base colour; change it to pick it yourself. Each text must stay legible on each background (the exact ratio is in the tooltip). A red indicator warns you that a text will be hard to read, without stopping you from saving.
scrimText: Text on the background of enlarged images
